periods.time: First day of the Tokyo Bay defense battle

name.zh: 首都防卫线与黑乃舰队奇袭
name.en: Tokyo defense line and Kurono's fleet strike

periods.location: Tokyo Bay coast and Pacific Fleet offshore
periods.summary: Tokyo enters chaos as shelters open and the U.S. landing force reaches the coast. Oreki's Violet Pane drops U.S. infantry with shared pain, while Renren and Ikazuchi smash EDY robots that ignore pain and destroy tanks. Offshore, Kirihara hides a helicopter with Area Invisible and Kagami multiplies his arrows, letting them cripple U.S. carriers and deliver Kurono into the fleet. Kurono destroys warships with Clock on Death, but Douglas Upton appears with his enormous flying Device Enterprise, beginning the duel that pins Japan's strongest available defender.
periods.cause: The Pacific Fleet attempts to land and bomb Tokyo; Japan deploys self-defense forces, professional knights, and selected C-rank students to hold the line.
periods.process: U.S. infantry, EDY robots, aircraft, carriers, and strong-particle weapons pressure the first defense line. Hagun students are used according to ability: Renren and Ikazuchi counter EDY, Kirihara provides invisibility, and Kagami multiplies his shots. Kurono then personally engages the fleet, only to face Upton's Enterprise.
periods.outcome: The first wave is held and Enterprise is prevented from landing, but Tokyo remains in a stalemate and Kurono cannot quickly return to Kyushu.
periods.significance: Shows why Tokyo requires Kurono and why Kyushu cannot expect quick rescue; also demonstrates Itsuki's efficient use of student abilities.
